title: A farming village on the Ganga plain
body: Ramesh's family has farmed the same fields on the Ganga plain for generations. His grandfather grew rice and wheat using only rainfall, and in dry years the harvest was small. Twenty years ago the family dug a tube well and began pumping groundwater to water the fields, and a canal from the river now reaches the village too. Harvests have grown larger and the family can now grow two crops a year. However, Ramesh has noticed that every few years the tube well has to be dug deeper, because the water table keeps falling. Several neighbours face the same problem. The nearby town has also grown crowded, and the river is more polluted than it was in his grandfather's time.
